alex: Morning all — quick async check-in for SLOs / alerting / oncall follow-ups.
What I did: rolled out the alert-dedupe patch to prod (applied to us-* clusters).
Blockers: still seeing a small spike in detect-queue latency in us-east-1 that's not explained by traffic.
Today: triage queue traces, update runbook for queue backpressure, review @jordan's PR for threshold tuning.

jordan: Thanks — noted. Can you paste the dedupe rule change? want to confirm no suppression of important signals.

alex: sure — it's a simple grouping window (30s) + collapse identical fingerprinted traces. Example rule we used:
```yaml
alert: DetectQueueHighLatency
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(detect_queue_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 250
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "detect-queue latency > 250ms (95th)"
# post-process: group_by: [fingerprint, job], dedupe_window: 30s
```
This keeps pages for distinct failures but reduces the flurry from duplicate worker restarts. :thumbsup:

sasha: FYI I opened SRE-487 to add an exporter-level suppression when we detect cascading retries. I linked the current runbook here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/detect-queue (please add notes).

maria: Oncall update: I received three pagers early AM for high detect-queue-latency in us-east-1 (03:12, 03:14, 03:21). Root cause for the first was a node OOM in pool-3, restarted the node, system recovered. Uploaded heapdump to s3://redwood-dumps/2026-03-17/maria/heap1.
Action items: add OOM mitigation steps to runbook, check node-level cgroup configs. I'm writing a short incident note.

lee: I can take main triage today after lunch — will look at queue traces and distribution of sequence lengths. Also can do the PR review @jordan this afternoon.

jordan: PR #1024 is ready: adjusts detect-queue 95th threshold from 250ms -> 300ms for batch jobs, leaves interactive jobs at 250ms. Small tests pass. Link: https://git.redwood/infr/alerting/pulls/1024 :eyes:

alex: sounds good. Maria — can you paste the short commands you ran to gather logs so I can replay locally?

maria: `kubectl logs -n inference deployment/detect-worker --since=30m --tail=500 | grep "OOM|killed"` and `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-dumps/2026-03-17/maria/heap1 .`

jordan: also pinging @product-security to make sure no sensitive payloads ended up in the heapdump before we share outside SRE.

alex: minor ops ask — can someone approve the infra-autoscale margin change in #infra-approvals? it's a tiny config bump that should reduce pressure in spikes.

lee: I approved it this morning. :thumbsup:

sasha: I'll take the runbook edits after you finish the incident note, Maria.

oncall-bot: Pager assigned -> maria: detect-queue-latency (us-east-1) triggered 3x, escalations suppressed by dedupe rule.

alex: thanks everyone. If no blockers, we'll keep this as the main thread for follow-ups — add any short notes here.

maria: added brief incident note to SRE:INBOX and flagged the postmortem template. Will update runbook by EOD.

lee: will post triage findings by 15:30 PT.

jordan: ping when you want the alert threshold PR merged — I can ship it after lee reviews. :rocket:

alex: great. closing the loop — next steps captured. :white_check_mark:
